summary: Solana web3.js bundle pattern review pending typosquat / scope verification
details: The @solana-labs/web3.js package ships a bundled CJS/ESM build (lib/index.cjs.js, lib/index.esm.js) that contains keyword co-occurrences typical of full-featured RPC client libraries: require('child_process'), https.get, and multiple fetch() calls. Pattern matches on these strings in a minified/rolled-up bundle do not by themselves distinguish a normal blockchain RPC client (which legitimately performs HTTP/HTTPS POST/GET against user-supplied RPC endpoints) from an exfiltration shape. No concrete evidence of hardcoded attacker C2 destinations, env-var scraping, credential-path reads, or install/import-time auto-execution is available in the captured evidence; package.json lifecycle hooks and top-level module side-effects were not corroborated. Note that the canonical Solana JavaScript SDK is published under the @solana/web3.js scope; @solana-labs/web3.js is a separate scope that warrants human verification of publisher identity and intent before publishing a verdict.
